theme: Personal finance basics: emergency fund, 50/30/20 budgeting, good vs bad debt
headline: Why Emergency Funds Matter Most
body: Keep 3-6 months of expenses aside. This safety net protects you from unexpected situations without derailing your goals.
caption: An emergency fund is your financial cushion. It prevents you from taking hasty decisions during tough times. Build it gradually, one step at a time. #EmergencyFund #PersonalFinance #FinancialSecurity #SmartMoney #WiseChoices
